return_on_equity.name: Return on Equity
return_on_equity.glossary: Return on Equity (ROE) measures how efficiently management generates profits from shareholders' equity capital. Calculated as Net Profit divided by the 2-year average common equity.

return_on_assets.name: Return on Assets
return_on_assets.glossary: Return on Assets (ROA) evaluates how efficiently a company's total assets generate earnings. Calculated as Net Profit divided by the 2-year average total assets.

return_on_investment.name: Return on Investment
return_on_investment.formula: Net income / avg2(equity + long-term debt + other long-term liabilities)
return_on_investment.null_rule: Null if average invested capital <= 0 or missing
return_on_investment.glossary: Return on Investment (ROI) gauges profitability generated from all long-term capital deployed (equity plus long-term debt and liabilities). Calculated as Net Income over the 2-year average invested capital.

roce.name: ROCE
roce.null_rule: Null if capital employed (total assets - current liabilities) <= 0 or missing
roce.glossary: Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) measures operating profitability relative to net capital invested in the business. Calculated as Operating Profit (EBIT) divided by Capital Employed (Total Assets minus Current Liabilities).

net_profit_margin.name: Net Profit Margin
net_profit_margin.glossary: Net Profit Margin represents the percentage of top-line revenue that translates into bottom-line profit after all operating costs, taxes, and interest expenses. Calculated as Net Profit divided by Total Revenue.

ebitda_margin.name: EBITDA Margin
ebitda_margin.glossary: EBITDA Margin measures operating profitability before the non-cash impact of depreciation and amortization and capital structure financing costs. Calculated as EBITDA divided by Total Revenue.

operating_profit_margin.name: Operating Profit Margin
operating_profit_margin.glossary: Operating Profit Margin indicates core business profitability by dividing Operating Profit (EBIT) by Total Revenue, reflecting operational efficiency before taxes and financing costs.

cash_flow_margin.name: Cash Flow Margin
cash_flow_margin.glossary: Cash Flow Margin expresses operating cash generation as a percentage of total revenue, assessing how effectively reported sales convert into real cash inflows. Calculated as Operating Cash Flow divided by Total Revenue.

cost_of_goods_sold.name: Cost of Goods Sold
cost_of_goods_sold.null_rule: Null for financial institutions and lenders, or if missing
cost_of_goods_sold.glossary: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) represents the direct costs incurred in producing or manufacturing the goods sold by a business during the fiscal period. Inapplicable for banks and financial institutions.

5y_avg_ebitda_margin.name: 5Y Avg EBITDA Margin
5y_avg_ebitda_margin.null_rule: Null if fewer than 5 consecutive fiscal years of data are available
5y_avg_ebitda_margin.glossary: 5-Year Average EBITDA Margin computes the arithmetic mean of the metric over the past 5 full fiscal years (FY0 through FY-4) to smooth out cyclical swings.

5y_avg_net_profit_margin.name: 5Y Avg Net Profit Margin
5y_avg_net_profit_margin.null_rule: Null if fewer than 5 consecutive fiscal years of data are available
5y_avg_net_profit_margin.glossary: 5-Year Average Net Profit Margin computes the arithmetic mean of the metric over the past 5 full fiscal years (FY0 through FY-4) to smooth out cyclical swings.

5y_avg_return_on_equity.name: 5Y Avg Return on Equity
5y_avg_return_on_equity.null_rule: Null if fewer than 5 consecutive fiscal years of data are available
5y_avg_return_on_equity.glossary: 5-Year Average Return on Equity computes the arithmetic mean of the metric over the past 5 full fiscal years (FY0 through FY-4) to smooth out cyclical swings.

5y_avg_return_on_assets.name: 5Y Avg Return on Assets
5y_avg_return_on_assets.null_rule: Null if fewer than 5 consecutive fiscal years of data are available
5y_avg_return_on_assets.glossary: 5-Year Average Return on Assets computes the arithmetic mean of the metric over the past 5 full fiscal years (FY0 through FY-4) to smooth out cyclical swings.

5y_avg_return_on_investment.name: 5Y Avg Return on Investment
5y_avg_return_on_investment.null_rule: Null if fewer than 5 consecutive fiscal years of data are available
5y_avg_return_on_investment.glossary: 5-Year Average Return on Investment computes the arithmetic mean of the metric over the past 5 full fiscal years (FY0 through FY-4) to smooth out cyclical swings.

5y_avg_cash_flow_margin.name: 5Y Avg Cash Flow Margin
5y_avg_cash_flow_margin.null_rule: Null if fewer than 5 consecutive fiscal years of data are available
5y_avg_cash_flow_margin.glossary: 5-Year Average Cash Flow Margin computes the arithmetic mean of the metric over the past 5 full fiscal years (FY0 through FY-4) to smooth out cyclical swings.

5y_avg_operating_profit_margin.name: 5Y Avg Operating Profit Margin
5y_avg_operating_profit_margin.null_rule: Null if fewer than 5 consecutive fiscal years of data are available
5y_avg_operating_profit_margin.glossary: 5-Year Average Operating Profit Margin computes the arithmetic mean of the metric over the past 5 full fiscal years (FY0 through FY-4) to smooth out cyclical swings.

1y_forward_revenue_growth.name: 1Y Forward Revenue Growth
1y_forward_revenue_growth.null_rule: Null - unavailable from official sources without consensus analyst coverage
1y_forward_revenue_growth.glossary: 1Y Forward Revenue Growth captures forward consensus growth projections based on aggregated sell-side research estimates compared to actual prior-year performance. Unavailable from official exchange sources.

1y_hist_op_cash_flow_growth.name: 1Y Hist Op. Cash Flow Growth
1y_hist_op_cash_flow_growth.glossary: 1-Year Historical Op. Cash Flow Growth reflects the percentage change in the metric from the previous fiscal year (FY-1) to the latest reported fiscal year (FY0).

1y_forward_ebitda_growth.name: 1Y Forward EBITDA Growth
1y_forward_ebitda_growth.null_rule: Null - unavailable from official sources without consensus analyst coverage
1y_forward_ebitda_growth.glossary: 1Y Forward EBITDA Growth captures forward consensus growth projections based on aggregated sell-side research estimates compared to actual prior-year performance. Unavailable from official exchange sources.

1y_historical_eps_growth.name: 1Y Historical EPS Growth
1y_historical_eps_growth.glossary: 1-Year Historical EPS Growth reflects the percentage change in the metric from the previous fiscal year (FY-1) to the latest reported fiscal year (FY0).

1y_historical_revenue_growth.name: 1Y Historical Revenue Growth
1y_historical_revenue_growth.glossary: 1-Year Historical Revenue Growth reflects the percentage change in the metric from the previous fiscal year (FY-1) to the latest reported fiscal year (FY0).

1y_fwd_op_cash_flow_growth.name: 1Y Fwd Op. Cash Flow Growth
1y_fwd_op_cash_flow_growth.null_rule: Null - unavailable from official sources without consensus analyst coverage
1y_fwd_op_cash_flow_growth.glossary: 1Y Fwd Op. Cash Flow Growth captures forward consensus growth projections based on aggregated sell-side research estimates compared to actual prior-year performance. Unavailable from official exchange sources.

5y_historical_ebitda_growth.name: 5Y Historical EBITDA Growth
5y_historical_ebitda_growth.null_rule: Null if ebitda_growth[FY-5] <= 0 or ebitda_growth[FY0] <= 0 or missing
5y_historical_ebitda_growth.glossary: 5-Year Historical EBITDA Growth measures the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) over a 5-year multi-year horizon ((FY0 / FY-5)^(1/5) - 1).

5y_hist_op_cash_flow_growth.name: 5Y Hist Op. Cash Flow Growth
5y_hist_op_cash_flow_growth.null_rule: Null if op_cash_flow_growth[FY-5] <= 0 or op_cash_flow_growth[FY0] <= 0 or missing
5y_hist_op_cash_flow_growth.glossary: 5-Year Historical Op. Cash Flow Growth measures the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) over a 5-year multi-year horizon ((FY0 / FY-5)^(1/5) - 1).

3y_historical_dividend_growth.name: 3Y Historical Dividend Growth
3y_historical_dividend_growth.null_rule: Null if DPS[FY-3] <= 0 or DPS[FY0] <= 0 or missing
3y_historical_dividend_growth.glossary: 3-Year Historical Dividend Growth calculates the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of Dividends Per Share (DPS) over the trailing three fiscal years.

5y_historical_eps_growth.name: 5Y Historical EPS Growth
5y_historical_eps_growth.null_rule: Null if eps_growth[FY-5] <= 0 or eps_growth[FY0] <= 0 or missing
5y_historical_eps_growth.glossary: 5-Year Historical EPS Growth measures the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) over a 5-year multi-year horizon ((FY0 / FY-5)^(1/5) - 1).

5y_historical_revenue_growth.name: 5Y Historical Revenue Growth
5y_historical_revenue_growth.null_rule: Null if revenue_growth[FY-5] <= 0 or revenue_growth[FY0] <= 0 or missing
5y_historical_revenue_growth.glossary: 5-Year Historical Revenue Growth measures the compound annual growth rate (CAGR) over a 5-year multi-year horizon ((FY0 / FY-5)^(1/5) - 1).

1y_historical_ebitda_growth.name: 1Y Historical EBITDA Growth
1y_historical_ebitda_growth.glossary: 1-Year Historical EBITDA Growth reflects the percentage change in the metric from the previous fiscal year (FY-1) to the latest reported fiscal year (FY0).

1y_forward_eps_growth.name: 1Y Forward EPS Growth
1y_forward_eps_growth.null_rule: Null - unavailable from official sources without consensus analyst coverage
1y_forward_eps_growth.glossary: 1Y Forward EPS Growth captures forward consensus growth projections based on aggregated sell-side research estimates compared to actual prior-year performance. Unavailable from official exchange sources.

pe_ratio.name: PE Ratio
pe_ratio.glossary: PE Ratio compares the current market price of a stock to its earnings per share. Lower multiples indicate potentially undervalued securities, while negative earnings yield null.

ttm_pe_ratio.name: TTM PE Ratio
ttm_pe_ratio.glossary: TTM PE Ratio compares the current market price of a stock to its earnings per share. Lower multiples indicate potentially undervalued securities, while negative earnings yield null.

forward_pe_ratio.name: Forward PE Ratio
forward_pe_ratio.null_rule: Null - forward earnings consensus unavailable from official exchange sources
forward_pe_ratio.glossary: Forward PE Ratio compares current price against estimated next-twelve-months or next-fiscal-year earnings per share based on analyst consensus.

pb_ratio.name: PB Ratio
pb_ratio.null_rule: Null if book value per share <= 0 or missing
pb_ratio.glossary: Price to Book (PB) Ratio measures the stock price relative to its net asset value (book value per share). Lower values can identify value investments or asset-heavy discounts.

ps_ratio.name: PS Ratio
ps_ratio.null_rule: Null if revenue per share <= 0 or missing
ps_ratio.glossary: Price to Sales (PS) Ratio measures market value against top-line sales per share, widely used for early-stage or cyclical companies with volatile net earnings.

forward_ps_ratio.name: Forward PS Ratio
forward_ps_ratio.null_rule: Null - forward sales consensus unavailable from official exchange sources
forward_ps_ratio.glossary: Forward PS Ratio measures current price against estimated forward sales per share.

dividend_yield.name: Dividend Yield
dividend_yield.glossary: Dividend Yield expresses the annual dividend income paid per share as a percentage of the current market price ((DPS / Price) * 100).

ev_ebitda_ratio.name: EV/EBITDA Ratio
ev_ebitda_ratio.null_rule: Null if ebitda <= 0 or EV <= 0 or missing
ev_ebitda_ratio.glossary: EV to EBITDA evaluates the total enterprise value relative to operational cash generation (EBITDA), normalizing across capital structure differences.

ev_ebit_ratio.name: EV / EBIT Ratio
ev_ebit_ratio.null_rule: Null if ebit <= 0 or EV <= 0 or missing
ev_ebit_ratio.glossary: EV to EBIT evaluates the total enterprise value relative to operational cash generation (EBIT), normalizing across capital structure differences.

ev_revenue_ratio.name: EV / Revenue Ratio
ev_revenue_ratio.null_rule: Null if revenue <= 0 or EV <= 0 or missing
ev_revenue_ratio.glossary: EV to REVENUE evaluates the total enterprise value relative to operational cash generation (REVENUE), normalizing across capital structure differences.

ev_free_cash_flow.name: EV / Free Cash Flow
ev_free_cash_flow.null_rule: Null if denominator cash flow <= 0 or missing
ev_free_cash_flow.glossary: EV / Free Cash Flow measures firm market valuation against underlying cash generation (free cash flow or operating cash flow).

ev_invested_capital.name: EV / Invested Capital
ev_invested_capital.formula: EV / IC (total equity + total debt + minority interest)
ev_invested_capital.null_rule: Null if invested capital <= 0 or missing
ev_invested_capital.glossary: EV to Invested Capital compares enterprise value to total capital employed (Equity + Debt + Minority Interest), analogous to Tobin's Q.

enterprise_value.name: Enterprise Value
enterprise_value.formula: MC + total debt + minority interest - cash & short-term investments
enterprise_value.null_rule: Null if market cap or balance sheet components missing
enterprise_value.glossary: Enterprise Value (EV) measures the total economic value of a firm (Market Cap + Total Debt + Minority Interest - Cash & Short-term Investments).

price_free_cash_flow.name: Price / Free Cash Flow
price_free_cash_flow.null_rule: Null if denominator cash flow <= 0 or missing
price_free_cash_flow.glossary: Price / Free Cash Flow measures firm market valuation against underlying cash generation (free cash flow or operating cash flow).

price_cfo.name: Price / CFO
price_cfo.null_rule: Null if denominator cash flow <= 0 or missing
price_cfo.glossary: Price / CFO measures firm market valuation against underlying cash generation (free cash flow or operating cash flow).

price_sales.name: Price / Sales
price_sales.null_rule: Null if revenue per share <= 0 or missing
price_sales.glossary: Price to Sales (PS) Ratio measures market value against top-line sales per share, widely used for early-stage or cyclical companies with volatile net earnings.

pe_premium_vs_sector.name: PE Premium vs Sector
pe_premium_vs_sector.null_rule: Null if stock multiple or sector benchmark is missing or non-positive
pe_premium_vs_sector.glossary: PE Premium vs Sector computes the percentage premium or discount of the stock multiple relative to its industry benchmark ((Multiple / Sector Benchmark - 1) * 100).

pb_premium_vs_sector.name: PB Premium vs Sector
pb_premium_vs_sector.null_rule: Null if stock multiple or sector benchmark is missing or non-positive
pb_premium_vs_sector.glossary: PB Premium vs Sector computes the percentage premium or discount of the stock multiple relative to its industry benchmark ((Multiple / Sector Benchmark - 1) * 100).

ps_premium_vs_sector.name: PS Premium vs Sector
ps_premium_vs_sector.null_rule: Null if stock multiple or sector benchmark is missing or non-positive
ps_premium_vs_sector.glossary: PS Premium vs Sector computes the percentage premium or discount of the stock multiple relative to its industry benchmark ((Multiple / Sector Benchmark - 1) * 100).

dividend_yield_vs_sector.name: Dividend Yield vs Sector
dividend_yield_vs_sector.null_rule: Null if stock yield or sector yield is missing
dividend_yield_vs_sector.glossary: Dividend Yield vs Sector calculates the percentage-point difference between the stock's dividend yield and its benchmark yield (Stock Yield minus Sector Yield).

pe_premium_vs_sub_sector.name: PE Premium vs Sub-sector
pe_premium_vs_sub_sector.null_rule: Null if stock multiple or sector benchmark is missing or non-positive
pe_premium_vs_sub_sector.glossary: PE Premium vs Sub-sector computes the percentage premium or discount of the stock multiple relative to its industry benchmark ((Multiple / Sector Benchmark - 1) * 100).

pb_premium_vs_sub_sector.name: PB Premium vs Sub-sector
pb_premium_vs_sub_sector.null_rule: Null if stock multiple or sector benchmark is missing or non-positive
pb_premium_vs_sub_sector.glossary: PB Premium vs Sub-sector computes the percentage premium or discount of the stock multiple relative to its industry benchmark ((Multiple / Sector Benchmark - 1) * 100).

ps_premium_vs_sub_sector.name: PS Premium vs Sub-sector
ps_premium_vs_sub_sector.null_rule: Null if stock multiple or sector benchmark is missing or non-positive
ps_premium_vs_sub_sector.glossary: PS Premium vs Sub-sector computes the percentage premium or discount of the stock multiple relative to its industry benchmark ((Multiple / Sector Benchmark - 1) * 100).

dividend_yield_vs_sub_sector.name: Dividend Yield vs Sub-sector
dividend_yield_vs_sub_sector.null_rule: Null if stock yield or sector yield is missing
dividend_yield_vs_sub_sector.glossary: Dividend Yield vs Sub-sector calculates the percentage-point difference between the stock's dividend yield and its benchmark yield (Stock Yield minus Sector Yield).

sector_dividend_yield.name: Sector Dividend Yield
sector_dividend_yield.formula: Median of positive Dividend Yields across sector
sector_dividend_yield.null_rule: Null if fewer than 2 peers exist in the sector
sector_dividend_yield.glossary: Sector Dividend Yield represents the market-wide median multiple computed across all actively traded peers within the sector.

sector_pb.name: Sector PB
sector_pb.formula: Median of positive PB ratios across sector
sector_pb.null_rule: Null if fewer than 2 peers exist in the sector
sector_pb.glossary: Sector PB represents the market-wide median multiple computed across all actively traded peers within the sector.

sector_pe.name: Sector PE
sector_pe.formula: Median of positive PE ratios across sector
sector_pe.null_rule: Null if fewer than 2 peers exist in the sector
sector_pe.glossary: Sector PE represents the market-wide median multiple computed across all actively traded peers within the sector.

mutual_fund_holding.name: Mutual Fund Holding
mutual_fund_holding.null_rule: Null if quarterly shareholding filing is unavailable
mutual_fund_holding.glossary: Mutual Fund Holding represents the percentage of total outstanding equity owned by this investor category according to official quarterly filings.

domestic_institutional_holding.name: Domestic Institutional Holding

foreign_institutional_holding.glossary: Foreign Institutional Holding represents the percentage of total outstanding equity owned by this investor category according to official quarterly filings.

promoter_holding.name: Promoter Holding

pledged_promoter_holdings.name: Pledged Promoter Holdings

pledged_promoter_holdings.null_rule: Null if promoter shares <= 0 or missing
pledged_promoter_holdings.glossary: Pledged Promoter Holdings indicates what percentage of the promoter group's equity stake is encumbered or pledged as collateral for debt financing.

retail_investor_holding.glossary: Retail Investor Holding represents the percentage of total outstanding equity owned by this investor category according to official quarterly filings.

no_of_shareholders.glossary: Total number of equity shareholder accounts registered in the company's official depository and registrar records.

mf_holding_change_3m.glossary: MF Holding Change – 3M measures the absolute percentage-point change in MF equity ownership over the trailing 3 months.

fii_holding_change_3m.name: FII Holding Change – 3M

fii_holding_change_3m.glossary: FII Holding Change – 3M measures the absolute percentage-point change in FII equity ownership over the trailing 3 months.

fii_holding_change_6m.name: FII Holding Change – 6M

fii_holding_change_6m.glossary: FII Holding Change – 6M measures the absolute percentage-point change in FII equity ownership over the trailing 6 months.

promoter_holding_change_3m.name: Promoter Holding Change – 3M

promoter_holding_change_3m.glossary: Promoter Holding Change – 3M measures the absolute percentage-point change in PROMOTER equity ownership over the trailing 3 months.

promoter_holding_change_6m.name: Promoter Holding Change – 6M

promoter_holding_change_6m.glossary: Promoter Holding Change – 6M measures the absolute percentage-point change in PROMOTER equity ownership over the trailing 6 months.

insider_trades_1m_cumulative.name: Insider Trades - 1M Cumulative
insider_trades_1m_cumulative.formula: Net buy-sell shares in 1M / shares outstanding * 100 (SEBI PIT)
insider_trades_1m_cumulative.null_rule: Null if no disclosure data or shares outstanding missing
insider_trades_1m_cumulative.glossary: Insider Trades - 1M Cumulative computes the cumulative net percentage of company equity traded through official disclosures over 1 month.

insider_trades_3m_cumulative.formula: Net buy-sell shares in 3M / shares outstanding * 100 (SEBI PIT)
insider_trades_3m_cumulative.null_rule: Null if no disclosure data or shares outstanding missing
insider_trades_3m_cumulative.glossary: Insider Trades - 3M Cumulative computes the cumulative net percentage of company equity traded through official disclosures over 3 months.

insider_trades_6m_cumulative.name: Insider Trades - 6M Cumulative

insider_trades_6m_cumulative.null_rule: Null if no disclosure data or shares outstanding missing
insider_trades_6m_cumulative.glossary: Insider Trades - 6M Cumulative computes the cumulative net percentage of company equity traded through official disclosures over 6 months.

bulk_deals_1m_cumulative.name: Bulk Deals - 1M Cumulative
bulk_deals_1m_cumulative.formula: Signed shares in bulk deals / shares outstanding * 100
bulk_deals_1m_cumulative.null_rule: Null if no disclosure data or shares outstanding missing
bulk_deals_1m_cumulative.glossary: Bulk Deals - 1M Cumulative computes the cumulative net percentage of company equity traded through official disclosures over 1 month.

bulk_deals_3m_cumulative.name: Bulk Deals - 3M Cumulative
bulk_deals_3m_cumulative.formula: Signed shares in bulk deals / shares outstanding * 100

bulk_deals_6m_cumulative.glossary: Bulk Deals - 6M Cumulative computes the cumulative net percentage of company equity traded through official disclosures over 6 months.

lot_size.name: Lot Size
lot_size.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
lot_size.glossary: Official exchange-mandated standardized market lot size for trading derivative futures and options contracts on this underlying security.

future_close_price.name: Future Close Price
future_close_price.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
future_close_price.glossary: Daily settlement price for the active near-month futures contract traded on the exchange.

future_volume.name: Future Volume
future_volume.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
future_volume.glossary: Total daily traded contract volume or open interest recorded in the active near-month futures contract.

future_open_interest.name: Future Open Interest
future_open_interest.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
future_open_interest.glossary: Total daily traded contract volume or open interest recorded in the active near-month futures contract.

fair_value.name: Fair Value
fair_value.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
fair_value.glossary: Theoretical fair value price of the near-month futures contract calculated using the cost-of-carry model (Spot * (1 + r * days/365)) with FBIL 3M MIBOR.

fair_value_spread.name: Fair Value Spread
fair_value_spread.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
fair_value_spread.glossary: Difference between the theoretical cost-of-carry fair value and the actual traded futures price (Fair Value minus Futures Price).

basis.name: Basis
basis.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
basis.glossary: Derivative basis representing the spread between the futures price and the underlying spot closing price (Futures Price minus Spot Price).

rollover_cost.name: Rollover Cost
rollover_cost.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
rollover_cost.glossary: Cost incurred by market participants when rolling open futures positions to the subsequent expiration cycle ((Next Month Price / Near Month Price) - 1).

percentage_rollover.name: Percentage Rollover
percentage_rollover.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
percentage_rollover.glossary: Percentage of open interest successfully transferred into the next expiration cycle relative to total open contracts across all active months.

calendar_spread.name: Calendar Spread
calendar_spread.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
calendar_spread.glossary: Spread between the settlement prices of the mid-month and near-month derivative contracts (Mid-Month Price minus Near-Month Price).

cash_carry_profit.name: Cash & Carry Profit
cash_carry_profit.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
cash_carry_profit.glossary: Theoretical arbitrage profit available by holding spot equity and shorting futures to expiration (Futures Price minus Fair Value).

put_call_ratio.name: Put Call Ratio
put_call_ratio.formula: Total Put OI / Total Call OI
put_call_ratio.null_rule: Null if total call open interest <= 0 or not F&O eligible
put_call_ratio.glossary: Put Call Ratio (PCR) measures total put open interest divided by total call open interest across all strikes and expiries, widely used as a market sentiment indicator.

call_open_interest.name: Call Open Interest
call_open_interest.formula: Sum of OI across all CE strikes and expiries
call_open_interest.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
call_open_interest.glossary: Call Open Interest is an official exchange-derived derivative indicator for F&O-eligible instruments.

put_open_interest.name: Put Open Interest
put_open_interest.formula: Sum of OI across all PE strikes and expiries
put_open_interest.null_rule: Null for cash-only securities; valid for F&O-eligible securities only
put_open_interest.glossary: Put Open Interest is an official exchange-derived derivative indicator for F&O-eligible instruments.

market_cap.name: Market Cap
market_cap.null_rule: Null if close price or shares outstanding missing
market_cap.glossary: Total market capitalization expressed in Rs Crores, calculated as the closing market price multiplied by total shares outstanding divided by 10,000,000.

close_price.name: Close Price
close_price.null_rule: Null if stock unquoted or missing bhavcopy
close_price.glossary: Official end-of-day closing price reported in the exchange bhavcopy.

1d_return.name: 1D Return
1d_return.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1d_return.glossary: 1D Return measures the historical percentage price appreciation or compound annual return over the designated holding horizon.

1w_return.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1w_return.glossary: 1W Return measures the historical percentage price appreciation or compound annual return over the designated holding horizon.

5y_cagr.glossary: 5Y CAGR measures the historical percentage price appreciation or compound annual return over the designated holding horizon.

1w_return_vs_nifty.name: 1W Return vs Nifty
1w_return_vs_nifty.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1w_return_vs_nifty.glossary: Excess performance of the stock over the Nifty 50 benchmark over the specified trailing timeframe (Stock % Return minus Nifty 50 % Return).

1m_return_vs_nifty.name: 1M Return vs Nifty
1m_return_vs_nifty.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1m_return_vs_nifty.glossary: Excess performance of the stock over the Nifty 50 benchmark over the specified trailing timeframe (Stock % Return minus Nifty 50 % Return).

6m_return_vs_nifty.name: 6M Return vs Nifty
6m_return_vs_nifty.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
6m_return_vs_nifty.glossary: Excess performance of the stock over the Nifty 50 benchmark over the specified trailing timeframe (Stock % Return minus Nifty 50 % Return).

1y_return_vs_nifty.name: 1Y Return vs Nifty
1y_return_vs_nifty.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1y_return_vs_nifty.glossary: Excess performance of the stock over the Nifty 50 benchmark over the specified trailing timeframe (Stock % Return minus Nifty 50 % Return).

away_from_52w_high.name: % Away From 52W High
away_from_52w_high.null_rule: Null if 52-week high is missing or zero
away_from_52w_high.glossary: Percentage discount from the 52-week peak price ((52W High / Close) - 1 * 100), indicating drawdown from yearly highs.

away_from_52w_low.name: % Away From 52W Low
away_from_52w_low.null_rule: Null if 52-week low is missing or zero
away_from_52w_low.glossary: Percentage gain from the 52-week bottom price ((Close / 52W Low) - 1 * 100), measuring recovery momentum.

daily_volume.name: Daily Volume
daily_volume.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
daily_volume.glossary: Daily Volume tracks the number of equity shares traded on the exchange over the specified trading window.

1m_average_volume.name: 1M Average Volume
1m_average_volume.formula: Mean daily volume over 21 trading days
1m_average_volume.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1m_average_volume.glossary: 1M Average Volume tracks the number of equity shares traded on the exchange over the specified trading window.

3m_average_volume.name: 3M Average Volume
3m_average_volume.formula: Mean daily volume over 63 trading days
3m_average_volume.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
3m_average_volume.glossary: 3M Average Volume tracks the number of equity shares traded on the exchange over the specified trading window.

1d_change_in_volume.name: 1D Change in Volume
1d_change_in_volume.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1d_change_in_volume.glossary: 1D Change in Volume tracks the number of equity shares traded on the exchange over the specified trading window.

1w_change_in_volume.name: 1W Change in Volume
1w_change_in_volume.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1w_change_in_volume.glossary: 1W Change in Volume tracks the number of equity shares traded on the exchange over the specified trading window.

face_value.name: Face value
face_value.formula: Official face value per share from security master
face_value.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
face_value.glossary: Nominal or par value assigned to each equity share by the issuing corporation.

current_ratio.name: Current Ratio
current_ratio.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or if current liabilities <= 0
current_ratio.glossary: Current Ratio tests short-term liquidity by dividing Total Current Assets by Total Current Liabilities. Inapplicable for banks and insurers.

quick_ratio.name: Quick Ratio
quick_ratio.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or if current liabilities <= 0
quick_ratio.glossary: Quick Ratio (Acid Test) evaluates immediate liquidity by excluding inventory from current assets ((Current Assets - Inventory) / Current Liabilities).

debt_to_equity.name: Debt to Equity
debt_to_equity.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or if equity <= 0
debt_to_equity.glossary: Debt to Equity ratio measures financial leverage by dividing total debt by total equity capital. Not applicable to banks or financial lenders.

long_term_debt_to_equity.name: Long Term Debt to Equity
long_term_debt_to_equity.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or if equity <= 0
long_term_debt_to_equity.glossary: Debt to Equity ratio measures financial leverage by dividing total debt by total equity capital. Not applicable to banks or financial lenders.

interest_coverage_ratio.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
interest_coverage_ratio.null_rule: Null if interest expense <= 0 or missing
interest_coverage_ratio.glossary: Interest Coverage Ratio measures the margin of safety for debt servicing (Operating Profit (EBIT) divided by Interest Expense).

cash_conversion_cycle.name: Cash Conversion Cycle
cash_conversion_cycle.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or missing working capital ratios
cash_conversion_cycle.glossary: Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) quantifies the days required to turn capital invested into cash inflows (DIO + DSO - DPO).

net_income_liabilities.name: Net Income / Liabilities
net_income_liabilities.null_rule: Null if total liabilities <= 0 or missing
net_income_liabilities.glossary: Net Income to Liabilities ratio gauges insolvency risk by comparing net profit against total debt and liabilities.

working_capital_turnover_ratio.name: Working Capital Turnover Ratio
working_capital_turnover_ratio.null_rule: Null if denominator asset <= 0 or missing
working_capital_turnover_ratio.glossary: Working Capital Turnover Ratio measures asset productivity by computing the ratio of annual revenue to the deployed asset base.

inventory_turnover_ratio.name: Inventory Turnover Ratio
inventory_turnover_ratio.null_rule: Null if denominator asset <= 0 or missing
inventory_turnover_ratio.glossary: Inventory Turnover Ratio measures asset productivity by computing the ratio of annual revenue to the deployed asset base.

asset_turnover_ratio.name: Asset Turnover Ratio
asset_turnover_ratio.null_rule: Null if denominator asset <= 0 or missing
asset_turnover_ratio.glossary: Asset Turnover Ratio measures asset productivity by computing the ratio of annual revenue to the deployed asset base.

days_of_inventory_outstanding.name: Days of Inventory Outstanding
days_of_inventory_outstanding.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or zero denominator
days_of_inventory_outstanding.glossary: Days of Inventory Outstanding measures operational efficiency in working capital management over the fiscal year.

days_of_sales_outstanding.name: Days of Sales Outstanding
days_of_sales_outstanding.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or zero denominator
days_of_sales_outstanding.glossary: Days of Sales Outstanding measures operational efficiency in working capital management over the fiscal year.

days_payable_outstanding.name: Days Payable Outstanding
days_payable_outstanding.null_rule: Null for financial institutions or zero denominator
days_payable_outstanding.glossary: Days Payable Outstanding measures operational efficiency in working capital management over the fiscal year.

earning_power.name: Earning Power
earning_power.null_rule: Null if total assets <= 0 or missing
earning_power.glossary: Basic Earning Power measures operational earning capacity independent of tax and leverage (EBIT / Total Assets).

price_momentum_rank.name: Price Momentum Rank
price_momentum_rank.formula: 0.6 * pct(12M return) + 0.4 * pct(12M return - sub-sector median 12M return)
price_momentum_rank.null_rule: Null if required historical data or fundamental ratios missing
price_momentum_rank.glossary: Price Momentum Rank is an open quantitative composite score (0-100 percentile or 1-10) evaluated across the active market universe.

fundamental_score.name: Fundamental Score
fundamental_score.formula: 1 + 9 * sector percentile of composite (valuation, profitability, growth, financial health)
fundamental_score.null_rule: Null if required historical data or fundamental ratios missing
fundamental_score.glossary: Fundamental Score is an open quantitative composite score (0-100 percentile or 1-10) evaluated across the active market universe.

value_momentum_rank.name: Value Momentum Rank
value_momentum_rank.null_rule: Null if required historical data or fundamental ratios missing
value_momentum_rank.glossary: Value Momentum Rank is an open quantitative composite score (0-100 percentile or 1-10) evaluated across the active market universe.

earnings_quality_rank.name: Earnings Quality Rank
earnings_quality_rank.formula: Equal mix of pct(net margin), pct(asset turnover), pct(CFO / net income)
earnings_quality_rank.null_rule: Null if required historical data or fundamental ratios missing
earnings_quality_rank.glossary: Earnings Quality Rank is an open quantitative composite score (0-100 percentile or 1-10) evaluated across the active market universe.

price_to_intrinsic_value_rank.name: Price to Intrinsic Value Rank
price_to_intrinsic_value_rank.formula: Percentile rank of P / Intrinsic Value (IV = median of Graham, FCF perpetuity, dividend models)
price_to_intrinsic_value_rank.null_rule: Null if required historical data or fundamental ratios missing
price_to_intrinsic_value_rank.glossary: Price to Intrinsic Value Rank is an open quantitative composite score (0-100 percentile or 1-10) evaluated across the active market universe.

percentage_upside.name: Percentage Upside
percentage_upside.formula: Mean analyst target price / Close - 1 (proprietary consensus)
percentage_upside.null_rule: Null - sell-side research coverage unavailable from official exchange sources
percentage_upside.glossary: Percentage Upside reports consensus analyst sentiment. Unavailable from official exchange data; can be populated from user spreadsheet uploads.

percentage_buy_recos.name: Percentage Buy Reco's
percentage_buy_recos.null_rule: Null - sell-side research coverage unavailable from official exchange sources
percentage_buy_recos.glossary: Percentage Buy Reco's reports consensus analyst sentiment. Unavailable from official exchange data; can be populated from user spreadsheet uploads.

percentage_hold_recos.name: Percentage Hold Reco's
percentage_hold_recos.null_rule: Null - sell-side research coverage unavailable from official exchange sources
percentage_hold_recos.glossary: Percentage Hold Reco's reports consensus analyst sentiment. Unavailable from official exchange data; can be populated from user spreadsheet uploads.

percentage_sell_recos.name: Percentage Sell Reco's
percentage_sell_recos.null_rule: Null - sell-side research coverage unavailable from official exchange sources
percentage_sell_recos.glossary: Percentage Sell Reco's reports consensus analyst sentiment. Unavailable from official exchange data; can be populated from user spreadsheet uploads.

no_of_analysts_with_buy_reco.name: No. of analysts with buy reco
no_of_analysts_with_buy_reco.formula: Count of analysts with Buy/Strong Buy rating
no_of_analysts_with_buy_reco.null_rule: Null - sell-side research coverage unavailable from official exchange sources
no_of_analysts_with_buy_reco.glossary: No. of analysts with buy reco reports consensus analyst sentiment. Unavailable from official exchange data; can be populated from user spreadsheet uploads.

total_no_of_analysts.name: Total no. of analysts
total_no_of_analysts.formula: Total number of analysts covering the stock
total_no_of_analysts.null_rule: Null - sell-side research coverage unavailable from official exchange sources
total_no_of_analysts.glossary: Total no. of analysts reports consensus analyst sentiment. Unavailable from official exchange data; can be populated from user spreadsheet uploads.

1y_max_loss.name: 1Y Max Loss
1y_max_loss.formula: Worst peak-to-trough drawdown over trailing 250 trading days
1y_max_loss.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1y_max_loss.glossary: Maximum peak-to-trough price drawdown experienced by the stock over the trailing 250 trading sessions.

sma_10d.name: SMA 10D
sma_10d.formula: Simple Moving Average of 10 daily closes
sma_10d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
sma_10d.glossary: SMA 10D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

sma_50d.name: SMA 50D
sma_50d.formula: Simple Moving Average of 50 daily closes
sma_50d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
sma_50d.glossary: SMA 50D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

sma_100d.name: SMA 100D
sma_100d.formula: Simple Moving Average of 100 daily closes
sma_100d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
sma_100d.glossary: SMA 100D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

sma_200d.name: SMA 200D
sma_200d.formula: Simple Moving Average of 200 daily closes
sma_200d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
sma_200d.glossary: SMA 200D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

ema_10d.name: EMA 10D
ema_10d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
ema_10d.glossary: EMA 10D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

ema_50d.name: EMA 50D
ema_50d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
ema_50d.glossary: EMA 50D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

ema_100d.name: EMA 100D
ema_100d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
ema_100d.glossary: EMA 100D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

ema_200d.name: EMA 200D
ema_200d.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
ema_200d.glossary: EMA 200D calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

alpha.name: Alpha
alpha.formula: Stock return - benchmark return over 104 weekly closes
alpha.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
alpha.glossary: Alpha evaluates risk-adjusted return and benchmark sensitivity using 104 weekly closes relative to the Nifty 50.

beta.name: Beta
beta.formula: cov(r_stock, r_bench) / var(r_bench) over 104 weekly closes
beta.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
beta.glossary: Beta evaluates risk-adjusted return and benchmark sensitivity using 104 weekly closes relative to the Nifty 50.

sharpe_ratio.name: Sharpe Ratio
sharpe_ratio.formula: (Stock return - benchmark return) / stdev(weekly excess returns)
sharpe_ratio.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
sharpe_ratio.glossary: Sharpe Ratio evaluates risk-adjusted return and benchmark sensitivity using 104 weekly closes relative to the Nifty 50.

relative_volume.name: Relative Volume
relative_volume.formula: Avg volume (10 days) / Avg volume (~91 days)
relative_volume.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
relative_volume.glossary: Ratio of average daily volume over the past 10 trading sessions compared to the 91-day historical baseline.

volatility.name: Volatility
volatility.formula: Annualized stdev of daily returns over 200 days * sqrt(252)
volatility.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
volatility.glossary: Annualized historical volatility computed from daily log returns over trailing 200 trading sessions.

volatility_vs_nifty.name: Volatility vs Nifty
volatility_vs_nifty.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
volatility_vs_nifty.glossary: Annualized historical volatility computed from daily log returns over trailing 200 trading sessions.

vwap.name: Volume Weighted Average Price
vwap.formula: Total traded value / total traded quantity from bhavcopy
vwap.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
vwap.glossary: Intraday Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) reported in the exchange bhavcopy.

price_above_1m_sma.name: % Price above 1M SMA
price_above_1m_sma.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
price_above_1m_sma.glossary: % Price above 1M SMA calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

price_above_12m_sma.name: % Price above 12M SMA
price_above_12m_sma.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
price_above_12m_sma.glossary: % Price above 12M SMA calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

price_above_1m_ema.name: % Price above 1M EMA
price_above_1m_ema.null_rule: Null if trading history is shorter than required lookback period
price_above_1m_ema.glossary: % Price above 1M EMA calculates the trend baseline using an arithmetic or exponential moving average of closing prices over the specified window.

rsi_14d.name: RSI 14D
rsi_14d.null_rule: Null if fewer than 15 trading days available
rsi_14d.glossary: Relative Strength Index (RSI) measures price momentum on a 0-100 scale, highlighting overbought (>70) and oversold (<30) market conditions.

rsi_exponential_14d.name: RSI Exponential 14D
rsi_exponential_14d.null_rule: Null if fewer than 15 trading days available
rsi_exponential_14d.glossary: Relative Strength Index (RSI) measures price momentum on a 0-100 scale, highlighting overbought (>70) and oversold (<30) market conditions.

adx_rating.name: ADX Rating
adx_rating.null_rule: Null if fewer than 28 trading days available
adx_rating.glossary: Average Directional Index (ADX) quantifies trend strength on a 0-100 scale regardless of directional movement.

macd_line_1.name: MACD Line 1
macd_line_1.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
macd_line_1.glossary: Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) tracks momentum shifts through exponential moving average spreads.

macd_line_2.name: MACD Line 2
macd_line_2.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
macd_line_2.glossary: Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) tracks momentum shifts through exponential moving average spreads.

from_upper_bollinger_band.name: % From Upper Bollinger Band
from_upper_bollinger_band.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
from_upper_bollinger_band.glossary: Distance of current price from the upper or lower 2-standard-deviation Bollinger Band over 20 trading days.

from_lower_bollinger_band.name: % From Lower Bollinger Band
from_lower_bollinger_band.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
from_lower_bollinger_band.glossary: Distance of current price from the upper or lower 2-standard-deviation Bollinger Band over 20 trading days.

from_parabolic_sar.name: % From Parabolic SAR
from_parabolic_sar.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
from_parabolic_sar.glossary: Percentage distance of closing price from the trailing Parabolic SAR level ((Close / SAR - 1) * 100).

williams_r.name: Williams %R
williams_r.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
williams_r.glossary: Williams %R momentum indicator oscillating between 0 and -100 ((Highest High - Close) / (Highest High - Lowest Low) * -100).

stochastic_k.name: Stochastic %K
stochastic_k.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
stochastic_k.glossary: Stochastic oscillator measuring closing price location relative to high-low range over trailing 14 trading sessions.

stochastic_d.name: Stochastic %D
stochastic_d.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
stochastic_d.glossary: Stochastic oscillator measuring closing price location relative to high-low range over trailing 14 trading sessions.

1w_change_in_obv.name: 1W Change in On Balance Volume
1w_change_in_obv.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1w_change_in_obv.glossary: Weekly percentage change in On-Balance Volume (OBV), measuring volume accumulation or distribution flow.

1w_change_in_ad_line.name: 1W Change in AD Line
1w_change_in_ad_line.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
1w_change_in_ad_line.glossary: Weekly percentage change in the Accumulation/Distribution Line based on money flow volume.

super_trend.name: Super Trend
super_trend.formula: SuperTrend(ATR 10, mult 3): signed distance + buy/sell flag
super_trend.null_rule: Null if underlying data point is missing
super_trend.glossary: SuperTrend trend-following volatility indicator based on Average True Range (ATR 10, Multiplier 3).

book_value.name: Book Value
book_value.formula: Total Equity reported in annual balance sheet
book_value.null_rule: Null if balance sheet filing missing or inapplicable to sector
book_value.glossary: Official audited balance sheet or cash flow statement line item (Book Value) disclosed in regulatory corporate filings.

cash_short_term_investments.name: Cash and Short-term Investments
cash_short_term_investments.null_rule: Null if balance sheet filing missing or inapplicable to sector
cash_short_term_investments.glossary: Official audited balance sheet or cash flow statement line item (Cash and Short-term Investments) disclosed in regulatory corporate filings.

total_receivables.name: Total Receivables
total_receivables.null_rule: Null if balance sheet filing missing or inapplicable to sector
total_receivables.glossary: Official audited balance sheet or cash flow statement line item (Total Receivables) disclosed in regulatory corporate filings.

total_inventory.name: Total Inventory
total_inventory.null_rule: Null if balance sheet filing missing or inapplicable to sector
total_inventory.glossary: Official audited balance sheet or cash flow statement line item (Total Inventory) disclosed in regulatory corporate filings.

other_current_assets.name: Other Current Assets
